summary: Building true financial abundance is a progressive four-stage journey that begins with **trading your time** to build valuable skills and earn initial capital. Instead of jumping straight into the stock market like most struggling individuals, you must next learn to **buy back your time** by delegating low-value tasks so you can focus exclusively on high-leverage work. Once your schedule is liberated, you can allow your accumulated **money to work for you** through smart, understandable, and long-term investments rather than short-term fads. Ultimately, the pinnacle of wealth creation is achieved by **owning equity** in businesses and assets rather than simply renting financial products, allowing you to generate massive, uncapped returns while securing true personal freedom.
